description: Complete all remaining gaps across the Seddly PRD — entitlements, auto-status updates, calendar permissions, CI/CD updates, tests, UX polish, and deployment config

userStories.title: Add missing entitlements to Seddly.entitlements
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the entitlements file to declare all capabilities the app uses so that code signing and App Review succeed.
acceptanceCriteria: Seddly/Resources/Seddly.entitlements includes com.apple.developer.applesignin with default scope
Seddly/Resources/Seddly.entitlements includes com.apple.security.application-groups with group.com.pearsonmedia.Seddly
Seddly/Resources/Seddly.entitlements includes aps-environment set to development
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: AuthService uses Sign in with Apple but entitlements don't declare it. CalendarService uses EventKit which doesn't need an entitlement but does need Info.plist usage description.

userStories.title: Add NSCalendarsUsageDescription to Info.plist
userStories.description: As a user, I need to see a clear permission dialog when Seddly requests calendar access so I understand why it's needed.
acceptanceCriteria: Seddly/Resources/Info.plist includes NSCalendarsUsageDescription with text explaining Seddly creates calendar events for commitment deadlines
Seddly/Resources/Info.plist includes NSCalendarsFullAccessUsageDescription with similar text
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: CalendarService calls requestFullAccessToEvents() but Info.plist has no calendar usage description. App will crash on first calendar access without this.

userStories.title: Build auto-status update service for overdue commitments
userStories.description: As a user, I want commitments to automatically show as overdue when their deadline passes so I don't have to manually update them.
acceptanceCriteria: Create Seddly/Sources/Services/StatusUpdateService.swift
Service scans all pending commitments and updates status to .overdue if deadline < now
Service is called on app foreground in LedgerView processOnForeground()
Service is called during background task processing in BackgroundTaskService
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Currently isOverdue is a computed property but statusRaw never actually changes to overdue. Entity overdueCount relies on both the stored status and the computed property, creating inconsistency.

userStories.title: Add New badge to recently detected commitments
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see which commitments were just detected so I know what's new since my last visit.
acceptanceCriteria: Add lastViewedDate tracking via UserDefaults (updated when user opens the app)
CommitmentCardView shows a small 'New' badge for commitments created after lastViewedDate
Badge disappears after the commitment has been on screen for one session
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: PRD §10.2 specifies new commitments should be highlighted with a New badge.

userStories.title: Add review banner after first backfill
userStories.description: As a new user, I want a subtle banner telling me to review my commitments after the initial backfill scan.
acceptanceCriteria: After BackfillView completes with commitments found, set a flag in UserDefaults
LedgerView shows a dismissible banner: 'Review your commitments — tap any to edit or dismiss'
Banner is only shown once (dismissed on tap or after first commitment interaction)
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add app badge count for overdue commitments
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see the number of overdue commitments on the app icon so I know at a glance if I have unresolved issues.
acceptanceCriteria: App badge number is set to the count of overdue commitments after each foreground processing run
Badge updates during background task processing
Badge is cleared when there are no overdue commitments
Uses UNUserNotificationCenter.current().setBadgeCount()
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Update CI workflow to include Watch target
userStories.description: As a developer, I need CI to build the Watch target so regressions are caught before merge.
acceptanceCriteria: .github/workflows/ci.yml builds SeddlyWatch target alongside main targets
.github/workflows/release.yml includes SeddlyWatch in archive and export
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: SeddlyWatch target was added in Phase 4 but CI/CD doesn't reference it.

userStories.title: Add api-commitments to Supabase deploy workflow
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the new api-commitments Edge Function deployed alongside the other functions.
acceptanceCriteria: .github/workflows/deploy-supabase.yml deploys api-commitments function
Function is listed alongside extract-commitments, generate-dispute-summary, subscription-webhook, send-silent-push
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: api-commitments Edge Function was added in Phase 4 but deploy workflow only deploys the original 4 functions.

userStories.title: Add unit tests for CommitmentSharingService
userStories.description: As a developer, I need tests for the sharing service to prevent regressions in reminder message and evidence summary generation.
acceptanceCriteria: Test generateReminderMessage produces correct format with entity name, summary, deadline
Test generateReminderMessage shows days overdue for past deadlines
Test generateEvidenceSummary includes all commitment fields
Tests use Swift Testing framework (@Test, #expect)
Tests pass

userStories.title: Add unit tests for EscalationTemplateService
userStories.description: As a developer, I need tests for escalation letter generation to ensure templates produce correctly formatted letters.
acceptanceCriteria: Test generateLetter for housing category includes landlord-specific language
Test generateLetter for freelance category includes payment-specific language
Test generateLetter populates commitment timeline with real data
Test availableTemplates returns all non-personal categories
Tests use Swift Testing framework (@Test, #expect)
Tests pass

userStories.title: Add unit tests for CommitmentTemplate model
userStories.description: As a developer, I need tests for commitment templates to verify all presets have valid data.
acceptanceCriteria: Test allTemplates has 9 entries
Test each template has non-empty name, icon, defaultSummary
Test templates cover housing, freelance, purchases, medical, insurance categories
Tests use Swift Testing framework (@Test, #expect)
Tests pass

userStories.title: Add unit tests for PrivacyAuditService
userStories.description: As a developer, I need tests for the privacy audit service to verify audit entries are recorded correctly and reports generate properly.
acceptanceCriteria: Test recordAIExtraction creates a PrivacyAuditEntry with correct eventType and textLength
Test recordDisputeSummary creates entry with commitment count in summary
Test generateReport returns correct counts and totals
Test exportReport produces formatted text with all sections
Tests use Swift Testing framework (@Test, #expect) with in-memory ModelContainer
Tests pass

userStories.title: Add unit tests for LocalEntity accountability score
userStories.description: As a developer, I need tests for the accountability score and grade calculations on LocalEntity.
acceptanceCriteria: Test accountabilityScore returns 0 for entity with no commitments
Test accountabilityScore returns 100 for entity with all fulfilled
Test accountabilityScore penalizes overdue commitments
Test accountabilityGrade returns A for 90+, B for 80+, etc.
Test shareableScoreCard contains entity name and score
Tests use Swift Testing framework (@Test, #expect)
Tests pass

userStories.title: Add unit tests for LedgerViewModel history limits
userStories.description: As a developer, I need tests for the tier-based history limit logic to verify free/pro/pro+ limits work correctly.
acceptanceCriteria: Test applyHistoryLimit with .free tier filters out commitments older than 30 days
Test applyHistoryLimit with .pro tier filters out commitments older than 1 year
Test applyHistoryLimit with .proPlus tier returns all commitments
Test bulk edit operations (bulkUpdateStatus, bulkUpdateCategory) update selected commitments
Tests use Swift Testing framework (@Test, #expect)
Tests pass

userStories.title: Add unit tests for ClipboardMonitorService
userStories.description: As a developer, I need tests for clipboard monitoring to verify commitment detection thresholds.
acceptanceCriteria: Test that text under 30 characters is ignored
Test that text below confidence threshold does not trigger prompt
Test that text above confidence threshold sets showClipboardPrompt to true
Test dismiss() resets all state
Tests use Swift Testing framework (@Test, #expect)
Tests pass

userStories.title: Wire Share Sheet Edit option for detected commitments
userStories.description: As a user sharing a screenshot to Seddly, I want an Edit option to modify the detected commitment before adding it to my ledger.
acceptanceCriteria: ShareViewController showConfirmUI adds an Edit button alongside Add to Ledger and Skip
Edit button navigates to a simple form with entity name and summary fields pre-filled from detected text
User can modify fields before confirming
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: PRD §10.4 step 5 says share sheet should have Confirm/Edit/Skip options. Currently only has Add to Ledger and Skip.

userStories.title: Add deep link handling for commitment share URLs
userStories.description: As a user, I want to open seddly.com/c/ links in the app to view shared commitment reminders.
acceptanceCriteria: SeddlyApp handles universal links for seddly.com/c/{id} pattern
When opened, navigates to the commitment detail view if the commitment exists locally
If commitment not found, shows a message that the commitment is not on this device
Add associated domains entitlement for applinks:seddly.com
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: CommitmentSharingService.generateShareableLink creates seddly.com/c/ URLs but the app doesn't handle them.

userStories.title: Add Watch entitlements and Info.plist
userStories.description: As a developer, I need proper entitlements and Info.plist for the Watch target so it builds and runs correctly.
acceptanceCriteria: SeddlyWatch/Info.plist exists with WKCompanionAppBundleIdentifier set to com.pearsonmedia.Seddly
SeddlyWatch/SeddlyWatch.entitlements exists with App Groups entitlement matching main app
project.yml references the Watch entitlements file
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Watch target was added in Phase 4 but has no entitlements or Info.plist files.

userStories.title: Add Supabase migration for custom workflow and privacy audit tables
userStories.description: As a developer, I need database tables for Phase 4 models that sync to Supabase for Pro+ users.
acceptanceCriteria: New migration file adds privacy_audit_log table with columns: id, user_id, timestamp, event_type, destination, data_summary, text_length_sent, commitment_id
New migration file adds custom_workflows table with columns: id, user_id, name, steps (jsonb), is_default, created_at
Both tables have RLS policies restricting access to own data
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: PrivacyAuditEntry and CustomWorkflow are in SwiftData but have no Supabase counterpart for Pro+ sync.

userStories.title: Add commitments category_raw and custom workflow fields to Supabase
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the Supabase commitments table to include the new Phase 4 fields for full sync support.
acceptanceCriteria: New migration adds calendar_event_id (text, nullable) column to commitments table
New migration adds custom_status_label (text, nullable) column to commitments table
New migration adds workflow_id (uuid, nullable) column to commitments table
SyncService push and pull handle the new fields
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: LocalCommitment has calendarEventID, customStatusLabel, workflowID fields that don't sync to Supabase.

userStories.title: Add PersistenceService implementation
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the PersistenceService stub to be implemented or removed to avoid confusion.
acceptanceCriteria: If PersistenceService is used, implement it with methods for common SwiftData operations
If PersistenceService is not used, delete the file and remove any references
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: PersistenceService.swift exists in Services but was not examined. Need to check if it's a stub or fully implemented.

userStories.title: Add Apple Sign-In UI to Settings for Pro+ account creation
userStories.description: As a Pro+ user, I need a Sign in with Apple button in Settings to create an account for cloud sync.
acceptanceCriteria: SettingsView shows a Sign in with Apple button in the Subscription section when user is on Pro+ tier and not authenticated
Button triggers ASAuthorizationAppleIDProvider flow
On success, calls AuthService.signInWithApple() and shows confirmation
Shows current account status if already signed in
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: AuthService exists with signInWithApple() but no UI presents the Sign in with Apple button anywhere.

userStories.title: Wire SyncService into app lifecycle for Pro+ users
userStories.description: As a Pro+ user, I want my commitments to sync automatically when I open the app.
acceptanceCriteria: SyncService.syncCommitments() is called on app foreground when user is Pro+ and authenticated
SyncService.pullCommitments() is called on app foreground to fetch remote changes
Sync only runs if user has an active Pro+ subscription and valid auth token
Privacy audit records cloud sync events
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: SyncService exists with push/pull methods but is never called from the app lifecycle.

userStories.title: Add website apple-app-site-association file for universal links
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the AASA file on seddly.com so universal links work for commitment sharing.
acceptanceCriteria: website/public/.well-known/apple-app-site-association file exists
AASA file declares applinks for com.pearsonmedia.Seddly
Paths include /c/* for commitment share links
File is valid JSON with correct structure
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Needed for US-017 deep link handling to work.
